problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a twice continuously differentiable function on R^d. Nonconvex objectives are permitted. There exists a global lower bound m with f(x0) − m ≤ Δ; attainment of the minimum is not required.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: A query (x, none) returns an unbiased gradient estimate g(x, ξ). Each query consumes a fresh IID seed; only the returned vector is supplied.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedAffineHessianVector.lean: spec.Query and spec.admissible, oracle answer and gradient unbiasedness clauses.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: A query (x, some v) returns an unbiased stochastic Hessian-vector product h(x,v,ξ), with expectation ∇²f(x)v. Gradient and Hessian-vector queries each count as one call against the same fixed total budget. No full Hessian or function-value oracle is supplied.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedAffineHessianVector.lean: spec.Query and spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: Algorithm.query, executeWithTrace and Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: The gradient is continuously differentiable and ‖∇²f(x)‖op ≤ L0 + L1‖∇f(x)‖ everywhere, with L0,L1 ≥ 0. No Lipschitz-Hessian condition is imposed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedAffineHessianVector.lean: spec.valid and spec.admissible, ContDiff and fderiv norm clauses.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: For independently specified p,q ∈ (1,2], E‖g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)‖^p ≤ σg^p + αg^p‖∇f(x)‖^p and E‖h(x,v,ξ)−∇²f(x)v‖^q ≤ (σh^q + αh^q‖∇f(x)‖^q)‖v‖^q. All four noise parameters are nonnegative. These are affine central-moment bounds, permitting infinite variance when the corresponding exponent is below 2. The Hessian-vector bound is directional, rather than an operator-norm moment bound on a random matrix.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedAffineHessianVector.lean: spec.valid and spec.admissible, gradient and Hessian-vector moment inequalities.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), with its Euclidean norm and d ∈ ℕ.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: All Params fields are public, including x0, Δ, ε, smoothness constants, noise coefficients and moment exponents. The objective, oracle maps and sampling laws are hidden admissible-instance data. Seeds are mutually independent with a common marginal law; the setup does not provide seed reuse across queries.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedAffineHessianVector.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput and spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: The output X is a measurable point in R^d, its gradient norm is integrable, and E‖∇f(X)‖ ≤ ε for ε > 0. The criterion uses the unsquared Euclidean norm; no last-iterate requirement is specified.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Expectation is over the joint algorithm and oracle randomness. The oracle-call budget is a fixed cap, rather than an expected stopping cost.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines gradient-dependent generalized smoothness with unbiased gradient and Hessian-vector oracles whose affine heavy-tailed central-moment bounds have separate exponents p and q. This combination is a meaningful departure from standard globally smooth, bounded-variance formulations.
